scope: Employment, attendance, leave, payroll, expenses, recruitment and performance as one integrated application
purpose: Self-contained arrangements and expected outputs for reimplementation. Values are deliberately invented conformance fixtures, not statutory rates.

verification_policy.inspected_transaction: Expected decision or transition read from the available decision routines; database operation and concurrency not executed.
verification_policy.isolated_calculation: Selected arithmetic routine invoked with controlled inputs and substituted nonfinancial context; no complete application runtime.
verification_policy.required_enterprise_invariant: Acceptance obligation needed for reliable replacement; not represented as already proved by a controller check.
verification_policy.compatibility_decision: Observed branch or failure whose preservation versus correction must be explicitly decided; the expected observed result is retained.
